name: io.github.assafbar2/agentswitchboard
description: In-browser WebMCP tools for Agent Switchboard, registered on document.modelContext when the page loads. Same three tools as the remote MCP server at /api/mcp. They call the public REST API (/api/agents, /api/agents/{slug}, /api/categories), so matches and their order are the same as the remote server's; result objects use the REST field names (see /openapi.json).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the curated Agent Switchboard directory of AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic tools. Filter by category slug, access methods, and/or official (first-party listings from major vendors). Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working. Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified. Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, skills, categories, tags, and provider
